Studies
on
proteins
have

the

of
several

different
mechanisms
capable
of
causing
changes
in
protein
thermal
stability .

On
an
evolutionary
time
scale ,
small
changes
in
amino
acid
sequence
of
a

protein
have
been
shown
to
affect
protein
thermal
stability
( Somero ,
1995 ) .

Differences
in

kinetic

of

from

different
thermal

have
provided

for
variation
